problems: @plotinium/kernel/sys is still a placeholder. The shell (and coreutils) keep using the shared stand-in apps/src/_sys.ts (Sys, Program, ProgramContext, SysError, writeText and readAllText), which carries TODO(R1).

The complete.query, complete.hist.load, complete.hist.add and complete.hist.clear calls are not in protocol/src/sys/names.ts. They are declared locally as ExtraCalls in apps/src/_sys.ts. Until they land the kernel answers ENOSYS: completion falls back to a directory scan (SHL-17) and history seeding is silently skipped.

Race until spawn gets an fg option: protocol SpawnArgs has no `fg` option (it is a strictObject, so the field cannot be passed). The shell therefore sets cooked mode before spawning and calls tcsetpgrp right after the first spawn. There is still a small window where the first process could read the TTY before it is the foreground group and get SIGTTIN (TODO(R1) in exec.ts).

Protocol and shell spec disagree in five places; I followed the protocol. (1) TTY attribute calls are tty.getattr/tty.setattr, not tcgetattr/tcsetattr. (2) tty.input is limited to 4,096 bytes, not the 16 KiB chunks in §3.2. (3) argv plus env is limited to 60 KiB, not the 128 KiB in §6. (4) There is no tty.ack or seq on tty.out; tty.ts serialises writes and reports a local sequence (TODO). (5) WaitStatus has no exitReason, so 'Killed (watchdog)' and 'Killed (collateral…)' cannot be told apart from plain 'Killed' yet.

Protocol strerror texts for EBUSY ('Device or resource busy') and ETIMEDOUT ('Operation timed out') differ from the shell spec §3.13 ('Resource busy', 'Timed out'). _sys.ts now has errnoText/errText with the shell-spec wording for terminal output. coreutils/lib/errors.ts has its own copy of the same override.

The spec lists the line editor at apps/shell/editor.ts and the line discipline in the kernel (kernel/core/tty). The editing, history keys and completion hook requested for 'tty' therefore live in apps/shell/{keys,editor,complete,repl}.ts. apps/terminal/tty.ts is the view-side device adapter: input chunking with EAGAIN retry per frame, and serialised output batches acknowledged after parsing.
The completion service's 200 ms timeout (§3.10) needs kernel support and is not enforced by the shell. `type` does not resolve names that contain '/'.
Other agents' paths, not blocking me: apps/coreutils/tests/{procs,system}.test.ts do not typecheck under `tsc -p apps/tsconfig.json` (3 errors). The apps vitest project still passes.
